cards.title: Play School Returns: Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: Play School offers a refreshing alternative to overstimulating children's programming that mimics smartphone attention-grabbing tactics. Parents can feel confident letting toddlers watch this thoughtfully-designed show without guilt.

cards.title: Managing School Holiday Chaos as Working Parent
cards.body: School holidays create significant logistical challenges for working parents juggling childcare and work schedules. Finding quality time with kids without constant work distractions remains nearly impossible for many families.

cards.title: Talking to Kids About Parental Conflict
cards.body: Children sense tension between parents and benefit from honest communication rather than being left to imagine problems. Telling children the truth, even difficult truths, helps them understand family situations better.

cards.title: Co-Parenting Teamwork Prevents Burnout
cards.body: New parents can prevent burnout by working together as a team rather than operating independently. Research shows that collaborative co-parenting makes everything easier and more sustainable.

cards.title: Building Confident Parenting Through Self-Focus
cards.body: The path to confident parenting starts by making yourself, not your child, the focus of improvement. Working on your own emotional responses transforms how you parent.

cards.title: Estranged Parents: Repair Through Accountability
cards.body: Parents seeking reconnection with adult children must work through shame and perfectionism to enable healing. Showing courage and accountability can support healthy repair of estranged relationships.

cards.title: Saving for Children's Future Through Pensions
cards.body: Growing numbers of parents are opening pension accounts for their children to build long-term financial security. Children may not access these savings until their late 50s, but the compound growth is significant.

cards.title: Childminder Convicted of Neglecting 27 Children
cards.body: A childminder pleaded guilty to neglecting and abandoning 27 children left alone in her care. This case highlights the importance of proper childcare oversight and accountability.
